purpose: frozen-checkpoint offline crossover of the native-HDR plugin source and exact-state high-frequency Direct-HDR source on two same-speed saved trajectories
query_selection: all exact saved state-trace rows in the inclusive query interval; no synthetic query states

causal_input.representation: existing five causal 5 ms bins, two polarities, 64x64, log1p counts

sources.ours_native_hdr: frozen Genesis event plugin on the exact cached native scene-linear HDR endpoint frames at 100 Hz; one episode-level DVS initialization at the shared first frame
sources.direct_hdr: Genesis HDR direct renders at every actual saved state row in the trace interval (approximately 1 kHz, nonuniform 0.5-1 ms); same physical_log response and one initialization at the shared first frame

response.luminance: linear RGB to linear luminance with shared radiometry helper

models.decoder: existing global soft-argmax and existing fixed-plane backprojection

allowed: GT image projection and planar error
full robot and target segmentation overlays
visual inspection of scene shadows in the direct display frame
heatmap peak and target-region probability mass

boundaries.physics: restore exact saved states and render offline; no physics advancement or new rollout
boundaries.history: each source initializes once at the identical shared first-frame time and processes continuously through the diagnostic segment; no per-query reset
boundaries.scope: the captured diagnostic segment starts at 0.5505 s; it is not a reconstruction of DVS state before that saved start
boundaries.rank: development diagnosis only; not generator ranking or independent test
boundaries.training: no training, checkpoint selection, control, or controller changes
